question: Which browser extension could be used to download an entire web page for offline use?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Web ScrapBook**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

• **Web ScrapBook** is a browser extension that allows users to save web pages for offline use.

• It is highly customizable and supports capturing all or part of a web page.

• Web ScrapBook can save web pages in various formats including HTML and MHTML.

• It also supports organizing and managing the saved pages effectively.
